info.title: Property Token public API
info.summary: API for the investor mobile app: reads (phases 1 and 1b) and reservations confirmed on the website (phase 2a, ADR 0018 amendment 1).
info.description:
Contract first: this document is the source of truth; the service validates every response
against it in its tests. Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details; OAuth endpoints answer with the
RFC 6749 error object. Timestamps are RFC 3339 in UTC. Money is an integer amount of minor units
as a string with an ISO 4217 currency. Investor resources are never cached by intermediaries.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: IETF draft 'The Idempotency-Key HTTP Header Field': the same key with the same body returns the same request (200); with another body it is a conflict (409). Scoped to the investor.

Link.description: RFC 8288 link to the next page (rel="next"), absent on the last page

Unauthorized.description: Missing, expired or revoked access token

Units.description: Whole token units as a decimal string

kyc.description: "review" is the neutral word for every review (tipping-off rules: never a reason)

fiscal_year.description: The fiscal year ending 30 June of this year

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the certificate content; verifiable on the website

amount.description: The net entitlement in the leaf

statement_matches.description: keccak256 of the published statement equals the statement hash on chain

SubscriptionRequest.description: A change the app asked for (reserve, cancel or withdraw). It changes nothing and moves no money until the investor confirms it on the website (signed in, documents accepted for a reservation, passkey step-up where available).

subscription_id.description: reserve: the subscription the website created, once confirmed (null before); cancel/withdraw: the subscription it acts on

oneOf.description: Pay this exact amount from the investor's own bank account by Raast with this code, before expires_at

OrderRequest.description: A market order the app asked for (limit order on the demo market). It places nothing until the investor confirms it on the website, which checks the price band, cash or free tokens and limits, then places exactly this order.

order_id.description: The order the website placed, once confirmed (null before)

MarketBook.description: The demo market's order book by price level (no investors shown).
